RESUME the paused branch wt/explosions-4 (its earlier session was cut off by a usage limit on another account; read its HANDOFF section and the shots/explosions-4 README first, then finish what is open, merge origin/main, gate, push). Original task: OWNER PRIORITY: make the explosions EXTREMELY AAA (owner, 2026-11-01). Car blasts, rockets, gas/propane, chain reactions, at noon, golden hour and night, from 5 m and 60 m. Read the three earlier passes first (CLAUDE.md "What a blast leaves behind", "The blast, second pass" BlastFX, "The blast at arm's length" Blast3 / BlastVolume) and judge frame strips against a 2026 AAA game (the fireball's shape and roll, black-body colour through AgX, the shockwave and heat haze, smoke that is lit and lingers and rises into a mushroom, burning debris and sparks that bounce, scorch, glass, the light the blast throws on facades and the ground, camera shake and audio punch). Fix the worst things in order. Fluid-like motion (curl noise advection on the volume), self-shadowed smoke, secondary explosions, fuel fire pools. Forward+ AND the web fallbacks. rc2-mayhem judges a staged combat shot that includes a blast: YOU own blast_*.gd / BlastFX / Blast3 / the blast shaders; rc2-mayhem only stages and reports. Prove with fx strips (tools/glshot/fx_shot.gd FX_TIMES=, tools/explosions_2/blast_room_shot.gd) before/after, and on Forward+ small scenes under lavapipe.

Boot script compile: on boot the game compiles ~650 scripts in one step (mac-launch HANDOFF section: ~15.5 s on the cloud box with a still picture, longer on the owner's Mac) because most scripts are one dependency cycle (preload()s, class_name types in signatures and consts). No behaviour change, the gate green, measure with tools/load_time/load_time.sh and the LOADING lines before / after.
